resources.string: Start a game on the top screen
Tap the top screen to place the building

Thor AoK plays from the data of Age of Empires II HD (Steam). On a PC or Mac, run the converter (python3 android/package.py --hd <Age2HD folder>), copy the OpenAoK-data folder it makes to this device (the SD card is fine), then choose that folder. The README has the steps.
This version of Thor AoK needs newer game data than the copy on this device. Make the OpenAoK-data folder again with this release and choose it.
Game data found and checked. The map plays on the top screen, the command deck on the bottom screen.
